description: This file defines the SSMQuickSetupClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides a client interface for interacting with the AWS Systems Manager QuickSetup service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to configuration management, tagging, and service settings.

classes.name: SSMQuickSetupClient
classes.description: A specialized AWS client to interface with the AWS Systems Manager QuickSetup service.

methods.name: createConfigurationManager
methods.description: Creates a new configuration manager within the service.

methods.name: createConfigurationManagerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new configuration manager.

methods.name: getConfigurationManager
methods.description: Gets details of a configuration manager.

methods.name: getConfigurationManagerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a configuration manager.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
